<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-02-2412-35-22" status="finalized">
            <milestone n="2. snang ba sel ba'i lugs" unit="section"/>
             sel ba la yang 2 las 
             <milestone n="a." unit="section"/>
             chos can snang <lb n="6b6"/> ba 'di rigs shes kyi dgag bya yin pas mi snang bar 'dod pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6795">rgya yon tan seng ge</rs> laso pa'o ||
             <milestone n="b." unit="section"/>
            rigs shes kyi dgag bya ma yin yang rigs shes kyi yul ma yin pas mi snang ste || dper na <abbr>dmig gi</abbr> rnaM shes kyi dgag bya sgra ma yin yang <abbr>mig gi</abbr> rnaM shes kyi yul ma yin pas mi snang ba bzhin zhes 'dod pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3810">gangs pa</rs> las pa'o || 
            de lta ma yin par rigs shes la chos can snang na chos can snang ba rigs grub du <lb n="6b7"/> 'gyur te rigs pa'i yul du bden  pa'i phyir zhes <abbr>zer ro</abbr> || || </seg></TEI>
